import.batch.announce.paused: Screen-reader announcement when one platform's lane of a bulk import stops. {platform} is a platform name (Start.gg, Challonge, Parry.gg); {reason} is one of the import.batch.pause.* phrases, lower case.
import.batch.announce.progressChecked: Screen-reader progress line during the check phase of a bulk import, every ten tournaments.
import.batch.announce.progressImported: Screen-reader progress line during the import phase of a bulk import, every ten tournaments.
import.batch.challongeCost: Under a bulk import's list: how many Challonge API requests this batch will spend, against Challonge's allowance per period.
import.batch.filter.label: Accessible name of the row of filter buttons above a bulk import's list of tournaments. Each filter shows rows in one state (ready, failed…).
import.batch.lane.minutesLeft: Estimated time left for one platform's lane of a bulk import, shown after the progress count. min = minutes.
import.batch.lane.paused: One platform's lane of a bulk import has stopped. {platform} is a platform name; {reason} is one of the import.batch.pause.* phrases, lower case; {n} is how many tournaments are waiting behind it.
import.batch.lane.waitingFor: One platform's lane of a bulk import is backing off because the platform asked it to slow down. Shown after the progress count. {platform} is a platform name.
import.batch.nextNames: Button moving a bulk import to its next step: {n} players in the imported brackets match an existing player by name only, and the next step asks whether each is the same person.
import.batch.pause.allowanceExhausted: Why a platform's lane stopped: the platform's API request allowance for the period is spent. Lower case, completes import.batch.lane.paused.
import.batch.pause.keyRejected: Why a platform's lane stopped: the platform refused the API key. Lower case, completes import.batch.lane.paused.
import.batch.pause.notFound: Why a platform's lane stopped: the platform refused this batch. Lower case, completes import.batch.lane.paused.
import.batch.pause.rateLimited: Why a platform's lane stopped: the platform kept asking us to slow down. Lower case, completes import.batch.lane.paused.
import.batch.pause.stopped: Why a platform's lane stopped, when no more specific reason is known. Lower case, completes import.batch.lane.paused.
import.batch.pause.unreachable: Why a platform's lane stopped: the platform did not respond. Lower case, completes import.batch.lane.paused.
import.batch.row.alreadyFollowed: Bulk import row for a bracket already on the site: the viewer's community already sees it through {community}, another community it follows.
import.batch.row.askCurator: Bulk import row for a bracket another community ({community}) already imported, when the viewer cannot follow it themselves.
import.batch.row.importFailed: Why a bulk import row failed, when the failure came with no message of its own.
import.batch.row.importedBy: Bulk import row for a bracket another community ({community}) already imported; a Follow button beside it adds it to the viewer's community.
import.batch.row.includeLabel: Accessible name of the checkbox that includes one tournament in a bulk import. {name} is the tournament's name or link.
import.batch.row.leftOut: After a bulk import row's state: the operator unticked this tournament, so the import will skip it.
import.batch.row.noSeries: The empty choice in a bulk import row's Series picker: file the tournament under no series.
import.batch.row.subdomainLabel: Accessible name of the picker for a Challonge organisation subdomain on one failed row. {name} is the tournament's name or link.
import.batch.skip.parryggTournamentOnly: Why a pasted link was skipped: it names a whole tournament, and only one event can be imported at a time. {example} is the shape of an event link, left as it is.
import.batch.skip.startggTournamentOnly: Why a pasted link was skipped: it names a whole tournament, and only one event can be imported at a time. {example} is the shape of an event link, left as it is.
import.batch.status.pending: A bulk import row's state while it is being looked up on its platform.
import.batch.step.samePlayer: Third step of a bulk import: confirm whether a player in the imported brackets is the same person as a player already on the site.
import.batch.summary.counts: After an imported bracket in the bulk import summary: how many of its players matched existing players, and how many were created new.
import.batch.summary.notImported: Part of the bulk import summary heading, joined to the other parts with commas: tournaments that failed or were paused.
import.batch.summary.overnight: Bulk import summary. {games} is a comma-separated list of game names whose rankings will be recalculated overnight rather than now.
import.batch.summary.retryFailed: Button: check again the {n} tournaments that did not import.
import.feedback.already.title: Title of the notice after an import that found the tournament already on the site; {name} is the tournament's name.
import.feedback.followed.covered: The event already shows on the viewer's community board because it follows {community}, which includes it.
import.feedback.offer.adopt: {community} is the importing community, which will become the event's owner.
import.feedback.offer.covered: The viewer's community already includes this event through {community}, a community it follows.
import.feedback.success.title: Title of the notice after a tournament was imported; {name} is the tournament's name.
import.form.checkMany: Submit button on the paste box when it holds two or more tournament links; {n} is how many.
import.form.game.detectedFrom: Shown after the game's name on the import confirm card; {platform} is the bracket site the game was read from (Challonge, Start.gg, Parry.gg).
import.form.game.override: {platform} is a bracket site; the <b> tags wrap the game name as that site spells it. Keep the tags.
import.form.game.unknown: {platform} is a bracket site; the <b> tags wrap the game name as that site spells it, which Dizzy does not know. Keep the tags.
import.form.links.allPickedUp: Hint under the paste box; {platforms} is a list of bracket sites already joined with commas and 'and'.
import.form.links.challongeCost: Challonge limits how many requests an account makes. {cost} is the estimated number of requests, {allowance} the limit, {days} its period.
import.form.links.overLimit: Follows the count of links found, after a · separator, so it starts lower case. {max} is the most links one batch takes, {excess} how many to remove.
import.form.links.platformOff: Why a pasted link was skipped: the community has turned off importing from {platform}, a bracket site.
import.form.rescue.explainer: A Challonge organisation's tournaments live at its own subdomain. The <code> tags wrap an example host; keep 'challonge.com' as is.
import.form.resume.unfinished: Offers back a bulk import that was stopped part way; {n} is how many tournaments it holds. Keep the <b> tags around the count.
import.form.series.none: Option in the series picker: file the import under no series.
import.modes.label: Accessible name of the two-option switch above the importer.
import.modes.links: Switch option: import tournaments by pasting links to other sites.
import.modes.results: Switch option: import an Event typed up as a Dizzy results document (JSON).
import.nameMatch.appearsIn: After a player's name in a bulk import: how many of the batch's events they entered. Starts with a · separator.
import.nameMatch.headingPeople: Heading over the name-match list of a bulk import, where each row is a person across several events.
import.nameMatch.knownAs: Appended after a · to a name-match option: the importing community has recorded this entrant's name as one this player enters under (an alias).
import.nameMatch.newPlayer: Option for an imported entrant: create a new player rather than match an existing one.
import.nameMatch.sameAs: Option matching an imported entrant to the existing player {name}.
import.nameMatch.sameAsSlug: Option matching an imported entrant to the existing player {name}; {slug} is that player's address on the site.
import.nameMatch.samePlayer: Question appended to the name-match heading: is each listed entrant the same person as the existing player?
import.results.check: Button that checks the document on the server and shows the confirm card.
import.results.choose: Button that reads a .json file from the device into the box. Nothing is uploaded.
import.results.done: Title of the success notice after a results document import.
import.results.guide: Link to the results document guide in the API docs.
import.results.kept: Tournaments the Event already has that the document does not mention. They are not deleted.
import.results.label: Label of the box a results document (JSON) is pasted into.
import.results.named: Count of people the document identifies by a player slug, so they are not asked about.
import.results.newTab: Screen-reader suffix for a link that opens in a new tab.
import.results.outcome: One line per tournament after the import.
import.results.ownedBySite: Shown when the document matches an Event no community owns (imported by the site), which a community cannot replace.
import.results.ownedElsewhere: Another community owns an Event with the same name and date.
import.results.problems: Heading over the list of problems in a results document.
import.results.readable: Live status under the box when the document is valid so far.
import.results.resend: Shown when the document matches an Event this door may update.
import.results.rights: Notice under the results document box.
import.results.rule.above: Problem: a number that is too big.
import.results.rule.advanceBackwards: Problem: an advancement into an earlier stage.
import.results.rule.advanceRange: Problem: an advancement band the wrong way round. Keep the field names as written.
import.results.rule.advanceSide: Problem: a starting side into a stage without sides.
import.results.rule.advancedNowhere: Problem: an entrant left in a bracket that stopped early (playedUntil) who does not appear in any later stage. Keep playedUntil as written: it is a field name.
import.results.rule.backToWinners: Problem: in a bracket written as played, an entrant with a winners-side set after losing on the winners side.
import.results.rule.below: Problem: a number that is too small.
import.results.rule.bracketTooBig: Problem: an elimination bracket too large to import.
import.results.rule.composition: Problem: the game does not allow this mix of solo and team entrants.
import.results.rule.dqWithScores: Problem: a forfeit that also has scores.
import.results.rule.duplicateId: Problem: two siblings share an id.
import.results.rule.duplicateTournament: Problem: two brackets of one game with the same name.
import.results.rule.eliminationOnly: Problem: an elimination-only field on a round-robin or Swiss stage. {field} is bracket or playedUntil, field names to keep as written.
import.results.rule.entrantFieldsWithPla: Problem: prefix or player on a team entrant. {field} is a field name, keep it as written.
import.results.rule.entrantUnplaced: Problem: an entrant who appears in no stage.
import.results.rule.fewItems: Problem: a list that is too short.
import.results.rule.gameNotInSet: Problem: a game names an entrant outside its set.
import.results.rule.gamesDisagree: Problem: per-game winners and the set score disagree.
import.results.rule.grandFinalPlayers: Problem: in a bracket written as played, a grand final between the wrong two entrants.
import.results.rule.idFormat: Problem: an id with characters ids cannot hold.
import.results.rule.invisibleCharacters: Problem: a name with zero-width, direction or control characters, which can make two names look alike.
import.results.rule.long: Problem: a text value that is too long.
import.results.rule.losersBeforeLoss: Problem: in a bracket written as played, an entrant on the losers side who has not lost yet.
import.results.rule.losersSeedsNotDouble: Problem: losersSeeds on a stage that is not double elimination. Keep losersSeeds as written: it is a field name.
import.results.rule.manyItems: Problem: a list that is too long.
import.results.rule.missingFromRound: Problem: a player missing from a Swiss round when the field is even (or more than one missing when it is odd).
import.results.rule.moment: Problem: an unreadable date. Keep the example values as written.
import.results.rule.notInGroup: Problem: a set names a player the stage or pool did not seed.
import.results.rule.notJson: Problem: the text does not parse as JSON.
import.results.rule.oneOf: Problem: a value outside a fixed list.
import.results.rule.outOfBracket: Problem: in a bracket written as played, an entrant who plays after being knocked out.
import.results.rule.pairTwice: Problem: a repeated pairing in a round robin or Swiss.
import.results.rule.playedUntilLastStage: Problem: playedUntil on the last stage of a tournament. Keep playedUntil as written: it is a field name.
import.results.rule.playedUntilMismatch: Problem: a bracket that stopped early (playedUntil) whose sets leave a different number of entrants in it.
import.results.rule.playerNotReturning: Problem: a player slug outside the importing community's returning players. Keep "player" as written: it is a field name.
import.results.rule.playsTwiceInRound: Problem: an entrant with two sets in one round.
import.results.rule.poolRequired: Problem: a set with no pool where one is needed.
import.results.rule.rematchNeedsSide: Problem: a pair who met twice, without the side that says which meeting a set was.
import.results.rule.required: Problem: a required field is missing.
import.results.rule.resetMissing: Problem: in a bracket written as played, a grand final won by the losers side with no reset. Keep grand-finals as written: it is a field value.
import.results.rule.resetNotOwed: Problem: in a bracket written as played, a reset that was not owed.
import.results.rule.roundGap: Problem: a gap in Swiss round numbers.
import.results.rule.roundRequired: Problem: a set without a round, in a Swiss stage or a bracket written as played.
import.results.rule.scoreOrder: Problem: scores the wrong way round.
import.results.rule.scorePair: Problem: only one of the two set scores.
import.results.rule.seededTwice: Problem: an entrant in two seed lists of one stage.
import.results.rule.seedsOnSplitStage: Problem: seeds on a stage that lists pools.
import.results.rule.seedsRequired: Problem: an elimination stage with no seed order. Keep "seeds" as written: it is a field name.
import.results.rule.selfSet: Problem: the same entrant on both sides of a set.
import.results.rule.setFitsNowhere: Problem: a set that does not fit the bracket Dizzy builds from the seeds.
import.results.rule.sideInStandings: Problem: a bracket side on a round-robin or Swiss set, or a round on a round-robin set. {field} is side or round.
import.results.rule.sideRequired: Problem: in a bracket written as played, a set without its side.
import.results.rule.sideSingleEliminatio: Problem: a losers or grand-finals set in single elimination.
import.results.rule.stageRequired: Problem: a set with no stage where one is needed.
import.results.rule.starterOnWinners: Problem: an entrant listed as starting on the losers side who plays on the winners side.
import.results.rule.stillInBracket: Problem: in a bracket written as played, more than one entrant is left when the sets run out. {n} is a number above 1.
import.results.rule.tooManySets: Problem: the document has more sets in total than one import takes.
import.results.rule.unknownEntrant: Problem: a set names an entrant that is not listed.
import.results.rule.unknownField: Problem: a field the format does not have.
import.results.rule.unknownPlayer: Problem: a player slug that matches nobody.
import.results.rule.unknownPool: Problem: a reference to a pool that is not listed.
import.results.rule.unknownStage: Problem: a reference to a stage that is not listed.
import.results.rule.unplayedMatch: Problem: a match of the bracket with no set. {side} is winners, losers or grand-finals.
import.results.rule.unplayedPair: Problem: a round-robin pairing with no set.
import.results.rule.wrongType: Problem: wrong kind of value. {expected} is a technical type name such as string or number.
import.results.tournamentFacts: Facts beside each tournament on the confirm card. {outcome} is replace or new.
import.results.viewEvent: Link to the Event that is already on Dizzy.
import.results.wholeDocument: Stands in for a path when a problem is about the whole document.
import.subdomain.label: A Challonge subdomain names the Challonge organisation a bracket belongs to, not a Dizzy community.
import.subdomain.placeholder: Placeholder of the free-text subdomain field.
import.subdomain.typed: Accessible name of the free-text subdomain field; {name} is the picker's own name.
